task_summary: Theory 2: sex-stratified psoriasis skin analysis + mLOY blood-arm feasibility

steps.title: Extract sex-gene signal from 89k object
steps.description: On the cluster (n003, scissor-r env), load reference_scissor_full.rds and extract per-donor mean expression and % expressing for Y-genes (RPS4Y1, DDX3Y, UTY, EIF1AY, KDM5D, USP9Y) and XIST. Confirm the meta.data columns (donor, condition, tier, celltype, scissor) exist.

steps.title: Assign and save donor→sex table
steps.description: Classify each donor male/female from high-RPS4Y1/low-XIST vs the reverse; flag any ambiguous donor. Save donor→sex table as an artifact. Cross-check against any sex field in the recount3 bulk metadata where donors overlap.

steps.title: Sex × tier composition
steps.description: Tabulate male:female ratio across NN/PN/PP tiers. Report descriptively; explicitly note small donor N and that PN/PP are paired within psoriasis donors (sex constant across those two tiers), so the informative contrast is healthy vs psoriasis donors' sex distribution.

steps.title: Sex-stratified single-cell DE
steps.description: Per lineage and within the Scissor+ gradient program, test sex-biased expression on the target axes (STAT3/JAK-STAT, IL-1/inflammasome, IL-36, endothelial vascular program). FindMarkers with recomputed BH-FDR over the tested gene family (not Seurat Bonferroni). Apply the sparse-gene detection-floor caveat.

steps.title: Y-linked & X-escape genes by tier within sex
steps.description: Test whether Y genes (UTY/KDM6C, KDM5D, DDX3Y, USP9Y) and X-inactivation-escape genes differ by disease tier within each sex — the skin-level shadow of the mLOY hypothesis. BH-FDR.

steps.title: Recover per-study sex metadata
steps.description: For the k=4 plaque-psoriasis studies (SRP035988, SRP165679, SRP126422, SRP065812), extract sex from each recount3 sra.sample_attributes; where absent, infer from XIST/RPS4Y1 in the expression matrix.

steps.title: Sex-covariate / interaction meta-analysis
steps.description: Re-run per-study DE adding sex as a covariate and a sex×condition interaction term; DerSimonian-Laird meta across studies. Focus on the project's target axes; report which genes are male-biased. BH-FDR, q<0.05.

steps.title: State the mLOY-in-skin limit
steps.description: Write the explicit statement that mLOY cannot be measured from skin biopsy (it is a hematopoietic Y-dropout phenomenon needing a diploid blood baseline); skin supports only sex-stratification.

steps.title: Screen GEO/CELLxGENE/ArrayExpress for psoriasis blood
steps.description: Search for psoriasis PBMC/whole-blood datasets with male donors and Y-chromosome coverage adequate for per-cell or per-sample Y-dropout. Exclude GPP. Build a feasibility table: accession, tissue, subtype, n male, platform, controls, mLOY-suitability verdict.

steps.title: Outline mLOY quantification if a dataset qualifies
steps.description: For any usable blood dataset, outline the quantification: per-cell Y-gene expression fraction (single-cell) or Y-vs-autosome coverage ratio (bulk), male samples only, vs diploid baseline; then mLOY burden ~ psoriasis status/severity.

steps.title: Summary figure
steps.description: Build a publication-grade figure (figure-style skill) summarizing any male/female differences on the project's target axes — single-cell and bulk panels — with sample sizes and BH-FDR flags.

steps.title: Theory-2 writeup + update living docs
steps.description: Write theory2_sex_mLOY writeup: donor→sex results, sex-stratified findings, Y/X-escape trends, an explicit honest statement of what the skin data can and cannot show about mLOY, and the blood feasibility table. Save all artifacts; append additive updates to DECISIONS_LOG/METHODS/PLAN. Cluster repo: additive commits only.

desired_outputs: sex × tier composition table + descriptive test
sex-stratified single-cell DE tables (per lineage, Scissor+ program, BH-FDR)
sex-covariate bulk meta-analysis on target axes (STAT3/JAK-STAT, IL-1, IL-36, endothelial)
Y-linked & X-escape gene tier trends within each sex
summary figure on the project's target axes (figure-style)
mLOY blood-dataset feasibility table (accession, tissue, subtype, n male, platform, controls)
theory2 markdown writeup with explicit skin-can/cannot-show-mLOY statement

feasibility.rationale: Part A (sex-stratified skin) is fully feasible on existing data — sex is cleanly inferable per donor and the 89k full-census object is on the cluster. Two honest limits carry throughout: small donor N (~18 psoriasis + 8 healthy) makes sex×tier associations descriptive, not powered; and PN/PP are paired within donors so sex is constant across those two tiers. Part B (mLOY) cannot be measured in skin — it is a blood/hematopoietic phenomenon — so that arm is a feasibility screen for a future blood dataset, not an mLOY measurement.
